result:
Round 87 verdict is **FAIL**, because of one medium bug. All 18 of B's acceptance rows pass in the real browser at both 1440×900 and 1280×720, but the new progress bar can't be seen at 1280×720 during an export.

**The bug (R87-PROGRESS-BELOW-FOLD-1280, medium):**
- **Steps:** at 1280×720, start an export (WAV or MP3).
- **What happens:** the dialog panel ends at 684 px and doesn't scroll on its own. The progress label (677–693 px) is cut off, and the bar (709–717 px) and the busy button (740–778 px) are below the visible area.
- **Workaround:** a mouse-wheel scroll on the panel brings the bar into view, but nothing tells the user it's there.
- **At 1440×900** everything is visible.
- **Why it fails the round:** the panel already overflowed by 12 px before this round; the new label and bar add about 100 px. No B row checked visibility, but the progress display is this stage's main visible result and 1280×720 is a required viewport. I measured this on the 5-minute project only.

**What works:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Main thread no longer freezes (5-minute project) | Worst frame gap WAV 106.6 / 105.0 ms, MP3 97.2 / 111.4 ms (1440 / 1280), against the 445 ms baseline and the 150 ms limit |
| 5-minute WAV | Exactly 14 611 488 frames, 24-bit / 48 kHz / stereo, exact message |
| 5-minute MP3 | Decodes to 304.406 s; matches the WAV with no offset and correlation ≥ 0.9998 on two time windows |
| 101.7 s project | WAV, MP3 and WAV + MP3 behave as in round 86; overload warning peak +1.7 dBFS, same as round 86 |
| Range 4–9 s and keyboard-only export | Pass at both viewports |
| Progress phases | Shown in order: render → WAV writing → encoder loading (no value) → MP3; values never go back; percent always matches the bar; absent before and after |
| WAV worker | One same-origin worker per export, none before the click |
| Second MP3 in the same page | Reuses the encoder; no second 31 MB download |
| CDN blocked | Exact error, no files, a WAV export still works, and MP3 works after the block is lifted |
| Encoder hangs | Timeout at exactly 120 000 ms with no late download; a second MP3 in the same page then completes (round 86 would hang here) |
| Network | No request to the ffmpeg CDN (unpkg.com) before the first MP3 export, no token or storage requests, no auth headers |
| Purchased Studio stays protected | `/studio/middle-east` asks for sign-in; `/api/studio-token` returns 401 without login |
| A's 70 targeted test files | 1195 tests pass |
| Source | Unchanged by me (7 changed + 10 new files, frozen list 490/490, protected files intact) |

I also blocked the new worker script on purpose (not a B row): the exact worker error appears, no file is created, there is no silent fallback to the main thread, and the next export works once it's unblocked.

**Blocked or not run:**
- The fake-Bearer → 403 check is blocked: the backend isn't available in the cloud (it returned 500).
- The production build (worker and MP3 in the built bundle) was not checked: there's no preview server here. Only the dev server was verified.
- Full test suite, build and `npm run verify` are left to root's gate.

**Notes for B, not bugs:**
- The bar fills plain green (#008000) in headless Linux Chromium, although the CSS colour is the correct brand mint. It needs a look in a normal Windows browser.
- The timeout message still says "reload the page", though a retry now works without reloading.
- The label sits at "render 100%" for about 0.27 s before the WAV phase starts.
- The WAV file hash varies slightly between runs. This is the known tiny rendering jitter, not a defect.

Two of my own first attempts were invalid: my MP3 accuracy check ran out of browser memory, and my script left the dialog open before a range drag. Both reruns are clean and valid, and the app page never crashed.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- `c-round-87.md`
- `c-round-87.json`
- `c-browse.json`
- `c-round-87/` (measurements, screenshots, scripts)
